scope: COV-019p: review existing continuation/completion auxiliary paths against every sense and example group of seven complete KRDict entries. No runtime or grammar catalog change.

decisions.decision: Both continuation/state-change and occasional repetition senses retain 어. Explicit adjective examples 어두워 가서 and 깊어 가고 있다 rule out a blanket verb-only left-class rejection. Second-sense examples 가며/가면서 are preserved without assigning that sense to other right endings.

Continuation 어 오다 preserves honorific, past, adnominal and connective source forms. 밝아 와서 is kept alongside other examples; no broader lexical/adjective restriction is inferred solely from the verb attachment note.

Retain source 어 connectors, contractions and right inflections, including nominal 기 + 가 and honorific + past. Verb-only source notes are retained, but this audit does not establish a general semantic or lexical-subset filter.
Keep both 어 completion/achievement and 고 completed-action connectors, with separate source sense/example references. Contextual differences and lexicalized compounds are not collapsed.

Twenty alternate 지/게/고 connector judgments forbid only the specified auxiliary-role group (고 remains for 나다). These do not reject sentences containing separate independent verbs. Present verb inflection and downstream auxiliary ownership are covered.

ambiguity.missing_compound: 번져나가다 is a raw lexical hypothesis absent from the dictionary fixture/full snapshot; dictionary filters retain 번지다 + 나가다. It is not labeled an attested compound.
ambiguity.source_examples_are: Exact spaced excerpts retained separately from tolerant joined test inputs. The tests are not spelling recommendations or cross-token parsing.

corpus.selection: First two tokens in source order for each of 가/오/나가/나/내/버리 with an explicit immediately preceding ecx and a px tag on the auxiliary. No matching joined 치우 token was found with this criterion in this training partition; dictionary examples cover that entry. Complete source sentences and original annotations are unchanged.

remaining: Semantic left-class and lexical-subset restrictions, including stative and negative attachments, require further review under COV-019.
Additional internal particles and particle chains were not licensed or forbidden by this audit.
Contextual sense selection, cross-token parsing and general spelling/spacing repair remain outside this token-level candidate generator.
Independent Korean-language review and a linguistic precision estimate remain pending.

raw_comparison.comparison: Full raw JSON equality, including order and provenance; regression/source changes only.

candidate_review.interpretation: Unjudged hypotheses remain explicit; neither passed judgments nor dictionary compatibility establish linguistic precision.

checks_passed: cargo test --locked --offline --features web (including candidate, dictionary, Unicode and stress regressions)

corpus.result: All existing per-case baseline checks passed; no baselines, source annotations or runtime/adapters changed.
